title: HARDBALL claims register — what the demo asserts, what it does not support, and what it withdrew
rule: A claim is SUPPORTED only if a committed artifact carries the numbers. A claim that failed its own test is NOT SUPPORTED, not softened. A claim the demo once made and withdrew is RETRACTED, stated plainly, not deleted.

claims.claim: The exact-optimizer rosters buy 48.9 WAR at the $171.2M floor, 52.8 WAR at the $208.0M middle, and 54.8 WAR at the $245.3M cap, each a proven optimum (solver gap 0.0) of 26 men within budget.

evidence.key_numbers: Floor 48.9 WAR / $171.1M; Middle 52.8 / $207.8M; Cap 54.8 / $245.2M; 26 men each; solver gap 0.0

claims.claim: The optimizer beats the greedy build at every budget: floor +6.9 WAR (48.9 vs 42.0), middle +7.1 (52.8 vs 45.7), cap +2.5 (54.8 vs 52.3). The greedy build is kept as the labeled benchmark, not hidden.

evidence.key_numbers: Greedy 42.0 / 45.7 / 52.3 WAR; optimizer 48.9 / 52.8 / 54.8 WAR

claims.claim: The optimizer rosters stay best when prices are wrong by 20%: at uniform price x1.2 the floor still buys 45.0 WAR (above the greedy base 42.0); the full ranges are floor 45.0-53.2, middle 48.5-55.5, cap 50.4-55.9 WAR.

evidence.key_numbers: Price x0.8 totals 53.2 / 55.5 / 55.9; price x1.2 totals 45.0 / 48.5 / 50.4; all proven optimal (gap 0.0)

claims.claim: Delivered WAR runs below the headline points: 10th-90th percentile delivered totals are floor 33.0-46.9 (median 39.8), middle 36.0-50.7 (43.2), cap 37.6-52.4 (44.9). The points are full-availability projections, at about the 95th percentile of the delivered distribution; nothing was re-centered.

evidence.key_numbers: Seeded Monte Carlo, 20,000 draws, seed 20261102; median gaps -9.1 / -9.6 / -9.9 = availability level -6.8 / -7.2 / -7.5 + residual bias -2.2 / -2.3 / -2.3

claims.claim: Injury risk is a level tax, not a budget effect: at the measured pool-mean availability the stressed totals are 44.6 / 48.1 / 50.0 WAR, and the floor roster still captures about 89% of the cap roster's WAR.

evidence.key_numbers: Pool n=201, mean availability 0.912; stressed 44.6 / 48.1 / 50.0; floor/cap ratio 0.892

claims.claim: The winning-cheap thesis is persistent, cap-efficient, and low-variance — but NOT proven undervaluation: the formal Hakes-Sauer proportionality test is inconclusive by power (Sample S p=0.42, Sample C p=0.90), while the run-value benchmark survives (OBP +0.262, SLG +0.278 per PA; ratio 0.94, 95% CI 0.72-1.17).

evidence.key_numbers: 480 team-seasons, 2011-2026; S n=60, C n=82; top-quartile contact hitters cost 0.54x / 0.53x median $/WAR (a contrast, not a price effect)

claims.claim: Our Marcel projections agree with FanGraphs Steamer 2027: hitters 201/201 matched, OBP r=0.889; pitchers 102/102 matched, ERA r=0.636, WHIP r=0.717. This is agreement, not accuracy — no 2027 outcomes exist yet.

evidence.key_numbers: Hitters OBP r=0.889, mean |diff| 0.010; pitchers ERA r=0.636, WHIP r=0.717; joined on MLBAM id only, never by name

claims.claim: On held-out 2026 actuals, Marcel beats the naive prior-season repeat: hitters (n=80) OBP MAE 0.0237 vs naive 0.0265; pitchers (n=22) ERA MAE 0.9394 vs naive 1.0177.

evidence.key_numbers: Hitters 2026 n=80; pitchers 2026 n=22; age slopes fit on 2025 only, judged on 2026 only

claims.claim: The salary basis is: Spotrac payroll totals for all 30 teams, with per-player contract rows for 24 of 30 teams (927 rows); Cot's LRP-2027 as a second, labeled basis (237 rows, 30 teams). On the Spotrac basis 7 teams are over the cap ($358.2M over) and 15 under the floor ($807.8M short); 13 of 30 teams change status between the two bases.
claims.location: Figure 10 (cap-era reality), Figure 11 (forced sellers), Cap Transition ledger panel

evidence.key_numbers: Spotrac gap teams: ARI, BOS, CHC, MIL, TB, TEX; Cot's basis is a committed-contract subtotal, not a complete payroll

claims.claim: Availability is measured, not assumed: hitter IL pool n=201 (mean availability 0.912), pitcher pool n=102 (mean 0.807). Health cards cover all 251 free agents (166 measured / 65 no IL record / 20 not matched, never assumed 100%), and ranking by delivered WAR changes the order (Trevor Rogers falls from headline #4 to delivered #6).
claims.location: Figure 14 (health) and the health-cards panel in Explorer 'Shop the FA Class'

evidence.key_numbers: Rogers: 64 IL days, 0.82 availability, 3.04 headline WAR -> 2.41 delivered; per-player intervals NOT derived (pool variance is not player risk)

claims.claim: The posted class is Sato (Hanshin, 3B/OF), Taira (Seibu, RHP), and Itoh (Nippon-Ham, RHP), posted November 1, 2026, window November 2-December 16, with BIS counting stats as stated. No NPB-to-MLB translation factor is claimed anywhere.

evidence.key_numbers: Sato 2026 .306, 39 HR, 106 RBI, OPS .992; Taira 1.36 ERA, 146.0 IP; Itoh 3.18 ERA, 172.2 IP; fee checkpoint $60M -> $10.875M

claims.claim: The tracker ticker separates what is confirmed from what is rumored: 321 SIGNED (from 705 FA-code transactions in the pull window), 200 REPORTED, 0 BUZZ. An item becomes SIGNED only when the MLB StatsAPI transactions feed carries it; REPORTED and BUZZ items are never labeled signings. The BUZZ lane ships empty because the Bluesky Jetstream read did not complete — never filled with substitutes.
claims.location: Tracker ticker panel, front of Story mode

evidence.key_numbers: Window 2026-10-27 to 2026-11-03; FA codes SFA / DFA / TR / REL / CLW / OUT / DES; Jetstream status stream_failed (timeout)

claims.claim: The evidence page reports the published research on injury recovery and prevention, as run on 2026-11-02: UCL return-to-play 157, injury prevention/workload 426, cellular recovery 404, tendon healing/biologics 119 (systematic reviews and meta-analyses). It is literature context for the availability thesis, not a model input, and not a biologics endorsement: the level-I evidence does not support PRP/platelet add-ons.

evidence.key_numbers: Query strings recorded verbatim in the artifact; 12 cards (3 per lane); every Finding line drawn only from the stored abstract

claims.claim: Figure 14's live-IL picture is drawn from the 2026-11-02 Statyx + FastballAPI pull: FastballAPI is the census (190 injury records), Statyx the event layer, MLB StatsAPI the standings of record. 13 of the 251 free agents are currently injured in that snapshot.

evidence.key_numbers: Union 196 players; Fastball/StatsAPI standings agree 30/30; first event comparison: 0 events (state-identical)

claims.claim: Input skills persist year to year: pooled contact r=0.843 across 457 player-season pairs (2022-2026 windows). The edge the demo buys is the persistent input, not the noisy outcome.

evidence.key_numbers: Pooled contact r=0.843, 95% CI 0.81-0.872, n=457 pairs

claims.claim: Run differential describes wins in the same season: run-diff-only logistic AUC 0.949 (2025->2026, titled 0.95) and within-season R-squared 0.545. This is diagnostic, not a forward forecast.

evidence.key_numbers: Run-diff-only AUC 0.949 (25->26), 0.970 (26->25); within-season R2 0.545

claims.claim: Prior-contract AAVs predict 2027 free-agent signed prices.

evidence.key_numbers: Verdict NOT RUN - TRAINING DATA ABSENT: the 5,153-signing census (2022-2024) carries no contract terms; Cot's terms cover survivors only (2022: 24 deals, all 3+ years). Anchors remain the optimizer input, labeled as anchors

claims.claim: A Steamer + Marcel blend improves on both parents for 2027 projections.

evidence.key_numbers: Verdict NOT ADOPTED: the blend cannot be scored — Steamer exists in-repo only for 2027 (unplayed); FanGraphs API ignores the season parameter. First honest test after the 2027 season

claims.claim: Steamer's out-of-sample accuracy is scored.

evidence.key_numbers: Steamer status NOT SCOREABLE: no held-out Steamer outcomes exist in-repo

claims.claim: Savant trait adjustments improve Marcel projections.

evidence.key_numbers: Bat speed is the most stable trait (YoY r about 0.92) and still made projections worse out-of-sample in both directions on both metrics; nothing adopted

claims.claim: Baseball-Reference salaries corroborate the Spotrac / Cot's salary basis within tolerance.

evidence.key_numbers: 114 matched vs Cot's LRP-2026, 71.1% within $50k — under the 80% bar, so no BRef salary dataset ships; disagreements are convention gaps (traded-player shares, deferred/PV), not errors

claims.claim: The demo's salary data is complete at player level for all 30 teams.

evidence.key_numbers: Per-player rows for 24 of 30 teams; gap teams ARI, BOS, CHC, MIL, TB, TEX (Spotrac page failures). Team payroll totals exist for all 30; CHC is over the cap by $4.0M with no shed set

claims.claim: The proposed $245.3M cap / $171.2M floor / 15% per-player max system is certain to govern 2027.
claims.location: Every cap figure in the demo (conditional)

evidence.key_numbers: System status: owners' proposed system; not law. CBA expires December 1, 2026; the demo conditions every figure on the proposal

retracted.claim: A team-level formula predicts wins with R-squared 0.80 and MAE 4.0 wins.
retracted.retraction: Cycles 18-19: the figure came from a favorable 2-year window. Refit on the full 2011-2026 panel (450 complete rows): repeated K-fold MAE 7.69, R-squared 0.534. The honest use-case spec — predict NEXT season's wins from this season's KPIs — gives in-sample R-squared 0.136 and out-of-sample MAE 14.05 (worse than naive 9.76); grouped CV R-squared -6.1. What survives is player-level acquisition (Marcel + injury caps), not a team-wins formula.
retracted.standing_record: data/formula_prod.json stays annotated 'DIAGNOSTIC ONLY — same-year fit; not a forecast'; the gate pins that annotation.

retracted.claim: Capping projections by measured availability improves point forecasts.
retracted.retraction: Cycle 54 backtest, pooled n=39 qualified FA regulars (2022-2024 classes, 5,153 signings screened): flat MAE 95.1 -> 132.3 capped; Marcel MAE 46.2 -> 61.1 capped. The cap helped 65% of the 20 Marcel-overshoot cases, so it is a downside adjustment, not a point correction. It shapes the Cycle 56 delivered-WAR distribution only; no headline point was changed.
retracted.standing_record: data/unc1_availability_backtest.json verdict NOT SUPPORTED; UNC-2 records the governance explicitly.
